caption: The drawing depicts three objects on a plain background. The largest object, located at the top, is a roughly rectangular wooden board with rounded edges, oriented vertically. The wood is colored with various shades of brown and has visible grain texture, giving it a natural appearance. There is a horizontal, rectangular slot near the top center of the wooden piece, flanked by two smaller, circular holes toward the bottom corners. A brown leather or rope strap is looped through these holes and draped across the front, with the ends tied together in a knot at the right side. The dimensions 7 3/8 inches wide and 8 3/8 inches tall are marked alongside this object. Below the wooden piece are two smaller, separate components: both appear to be made from slender, curved, brown material (possibly leather or rope). The longer component, positioned at the lower left, forms an angular shape with an additional loop and knot, while the shorter component at the bottom right consists of a short, curved segment with a small loop or knot at one end. The composition is technically rendered, with careful shading, to clearly display the structure and details of each object.
title: Bog Shoe for Horse
